gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.sola: A furnace powered by sunlight instead of fuel. It needs clear sky access above the block.

Sunlight ramps from a trickle at sunrise to full strength at noon, then back down toward sunset. Peak cook speed is 70% of a normal furnace at noon. Each Overclock adds its speed bonus on top of that, with no extra speed cap.

Rain cuts that roughly in half, and thunderstorms cut it further. At night or when blocked from the sky it stops completely.
When disabled, place, break, and dropper sounds are skipped. The machine still acts.
These sliders change the color of the range highlight
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.simp: On a redstone pulse it picks a random block from those slots and places it in front of its face.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.adva:
Places blocks in a set volume.

Uses 100 energy per block placed at a full default tank. Each block further from the machine adds 100 energy. Above 100k stored FE, both speed and cost scale together (200k is 2× speed and 2× cost).

Installing Energy upgrades does not slow a full default tank; extra stored energy goes faster and costs more per place.

Will use the same vanilla logic, picking a block at random from inventory to place down.

Breaks blocks in a set volume.

Uses 100 energy per block break at a full default tank. Each block further from the machine adds 100 energy. Harder blocks take extra hits and extra energy (obsidian takes 4 hits and 4× energy). Above 100k stored FE, both speed and cost scale together (200k is 2× speed and 2× cost).

Installing Energy upgrades does not slow a full default tank; extra stored energy goes faster and costs more per hit.

Insert a pickaxe in the dedicated slot; Fortune and Silk Touch apply. Efficiency on the pickaxe reduces hits (Efficiency V breaks obsidian in one hit) but not the extra energy.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.fish:
Place it waterlogged with water sources on all four sides. Insert a fishing rod to catch fish and junk; Lure and Luck of the Sea apply, and the rod takes durability. 

Fortune vanilla treasure in open water (up to 90% force chance). Treasure Mesh replaces that loot with a custom table.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.fishnet.need_wa: Needs to be waterlogged with water sources on all four sides
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fishnet.info:
An underwater fish trap. Place it in water so it is waterlogged and every horizontal side touches a water source, then insert a fishing rod.

Periodically rolls vanilla fishing loot into its 9 slots. Without Fortune Mesh that is fish and junk only. Rod enchantments (Lure, Luck of the Sea, Unbreaking) apply, and each catch costs durability. Fortune Mesh unlocks vanilla treasure in open water (the same check as a fishing bobber; a 3×3 pond is not enough) and raises the chance to force it, capped at 90%. Treasure Mesh replaces catches with a custom config loot table and overwrites Fortune Mesh. When a catch is about to finish, a fish swims toward the net as a visual effect.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.simple_block_br:
Place facing any direction, including up and down. A redstone pulse hits the block in front of its face.

Harvests at iron mining level using a fake player, as if mined with an iron pickaxe. Soft blocks break in one pulse. Harder blocks take extra pulses with a visible crack overlay (scaled so obsidian would take 4 hits). Blocks that need diamond or better (such as obsidian) are left alone.

Drops are pushed out the back like a dropper: into a hopper or chest if one is there, otherwise spat into the world with a slight random spread.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_block_:
Powered breaker with a working volume. While redstone allows it, it auto-runs and hits matching blocks, staying on a block until it breaks.

Range inflates a box around the offset; offset is in world axes from the machine (default: one block in front).

Speed and cost both follow stored FE against the default 100,000 buffer (100k = one hit per tick at the base 100 FE per block of distance). Energy upgrades raise the cap so extra stored FE goes faster and costs more per hit (200k = 2× speed and 2× cost; a full upgraded tank can do several hits per tick). Installing Energy upgrades does not slow a machine that already holds 100k.

Base cost is 100 FE per block of Chebyshev distance (minimum 100), reduced by Efficiency upgrades, then scaled by stored FE above 100k. Harder blocks take extra hits with a visible crack overlay and multiply that energy cost (obsidian: 4 hits and 4× energy). Energy upgrades grow the buffer and intake. Range upgrades raise the 20-block cap.

Empty pickaxe slot: diamond harvest level, no durability. Inserted pickaxe: mining level, Fortune, Silk Touch, Unbreaking, and durability all apply. Efficiency on the pickaxe reduces hits (Efficiency V breaks obsidian in one hit) but the extra energy still applies. Ghost filters support blacklist or whitelist. Drops eject from the back like a dropper. Mute skips extra sounds. Overlay draws the volume. Other mods can fill the FE buffer.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.simple_block_pl:
Place facing any direction, including up and down. Has 9 dispenser-like slots that hoppers can fill.

A redstone pulse picks a random block from the inventory and places it in front of the face.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_block_:
Powered placer with a 9-slot inventory and a working volume. While redstone allows it, it auto-runs and places matching blocks from its inventory.

Range inflates a box around the offset; offset is in world axes from the machine (default: one block in front).

Speed and cost both follow stored FE against the default 100,000 buffer (100k = one place per tick at the base 100 FE per block of distance). Energy upgrades raise the cap so extra stored FE goes faster and costs more per place (200k = 2× speed and 2× cost; a full upgraded tank can place several blocks per tick). Installing Energy upgrades does not slow a machine that already holds 100k.

Base cost is 100 FE per block of Chebyshev distance (minimum 100), reduced by Efficiency upgrades, then scaled by stored FE above 100k. Energy upgrades grow the buffer and intake. Range upgrades raise the 5-block cap. Ghost filters support blacklist or whitelist. Hoppers access the 9 slots. Mute skips place sounds. Overlay draws the volume. Other mods can fill the FE buffer.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.solar_furnace.p: Peak cook speed: %s%% of a furnace
gui.dopasrandomutilities.solar_furnace.s: This furnace needs an unobstructed view of the sky.
The sun must be in the sky for this furnace to run.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.solar_furnace.i:
A furnace powered by sunlight instead of fuel.

Needs clear sky access above the block and the sun in the sky. Speed peaks around noon at 70%% of a normal furnace, and slows near sunrise and sunset. Rain cuts that roughly in half, and thunderstorms cut it further. At night or when blocked from the sky it stops completely.

Smelting XP is stored like a vanilla furnace and awarded when you take the output (or when the block is broken). Accepts Overclock upgrades to raise peak noon speed by the configured overclock bonus per upgrade, with no extra speed cap.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.dev_null.info:
A handheld void filter. Put an item in its slot; once that stack reaches its limit, further pickups of that item are automatically voided.

You can also insert items manually to destroy them. Use the selected slot as a stand-in for that item when interacting with the world. 

Block placing from the selected slot is off by default.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_dev_nu:
An upgraded handheld void filter with expandable slots, multiple pages, and configurable stack limits.

Put items in filter slots to void matching pickups once each slot is full. Right-click a block to place from the selected slot. 

Shift-right-click opens the configuration UI for slots, pages, stack size, and cosmetics.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.mini_chest.info: A tiny one-slot chest. Stores a single item stack and works with hoppers and other inventory automation.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.trash_can.info:
A single-slot disposal block. Inserted items are kept up to a normal stack size; anything beyond that is voided. Changing the stored item type voids the previous stack.

Ghost filter slots support blacklist or whitelist mode so automation only voids what you allow.
Emits a redstone pulse on a configurable cycle.

Interval is the full cycle length in ticks; pulse length is how long the signal stays powered within each cycle.

The spinning face is cosmetic and shows whether the clock is allowed to run.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.basic_item_coll:
Attach to any block face. Vacuums nearby item entities into the inventory behind the collector.

Ghost filter slots support blacklist or whitelist, with configurable pickup range, delay, and batch size. Accepts Range upgrades to raise the max pickup range.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_item_c:
Attach to any block face. Vacuums nearby item entities into the inventory behind the collector.

Supports blacklist or whitelist filtering, larger range and batch size, redstone control, and a range overlay. Accepts Range upgrades to raise the max pickup range.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.tiny_tnt.info: A pocket-sized TNT. Lights like vanilla TNT (flint and steel, fire charge, redstone, fire, or another explosion) and uses the same fuse flash, but the boom is much smaller and higher-pitched.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.wood_chip.info:
Dropped when a Tiny TNT explodes a wood log.

Always drop 1 chip with a tiny chance to get a few more at 50%, 25% and 5% chance, a maximum of 4 chips.
block.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_pipe:
Connects nodes to nearby inventories. 

Shift-right-click with an empty hand to disconnect the connected nodes and Shift-right-click again to re-connected.
block.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node: Pulls matching items from an inventory through connected pipes
Pulls matching fluids from a tank through connected pipes
Pulls energy from a buffer through connected pipes
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.tran: Attach the plate to a source inventory. Matching items are pulled out and sent through connected pipes into inventories the pipes touch. Ghost filter slots support whitelist or blacklist, including the Filter item. Empty filters allow everything.

By default this head moves one item every 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades shorten that interval using the same speed bonus as other machines. Redstone dust connects to the node plate; use the Redstone panel to ignore, require a signal, or require no signal.

Overclock upgrades speed this head up (maximum 40). A Stack upgrade (maximum one) makes each transfer move up to 64 items, mixing types. A sword counts as 1, a stack of 16 snowballs counts as 16, and the head keeps going until it hits 64 or the source is empty. Overclock and Stack are per head.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node.v: Visual only, shows last pulled item
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.tran: Attach the plate to a source tank. Matching fluids are pulled out and sent through connected pipes into tanks the pipes touch. Ghost filter slots use buckets as fluid filters (whitelist or blacklist). Empty filters allow everything.

By default this head moves 100 mB every 40 ticks. Overclock upgrades shorten that interval using the same speed bonus as other machines. Redstone dust connects to the node plate; use the Redstone panel to ignore, require a signal, or require no signal.
Overclock upgrades speed this head up (maximum 40). Fluid Capacity upgrades add 10% of the base pull per upgrade (not compounding, maximum 64). Overclock and Fluid Capacity are per head.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node_f: Visual only, shows last pulled fluid
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.tran: Attach the plate to an energy buffer. Energy is pulled out and sent through connected pipes into machines or cells the pipes touch. This head has no item filter.

By default this head moves 50 FE/t every 20 ticks. Overclock upgrades shorten that interval using the same speed bonus as other machines. Redstone dust connects to the node plate; use the Redstone panel to ignore, require a signal, or require no signal.
Overclock upgrades speed this head up (maximum 40). Energy upgrades add 25% of the base pull per upgrade (not compounding, maximum 64). This head has no FE buffer. Overclock and Energy are per head.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node.i:
Attach to a source inventory. Pulls matching items through connected pipes into inventories the pipes touch. Sneak-right-click the pipe to remove it, or a joint to disconnect it.

By default it pulls one matching item every 40 ticks and inserts it into the next inventory a connected pipe is touching.

Ghost filter slots work like the Advanced Item Collector: whitelist or blacklist, including the Filter item. Empty slots allow everything.

Accepts Overclock upgrades to speed up transfers (maximum 40), and one Stack upgrade to move up to 64 items per transfer (non-stackable items count as 1). Redstone control is per head.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node_f:
Attach to a source tank. Pulls matching fluids through connected pipes into tanks the pipes touch.

By default it pulls 100 mB every 40 ticks. Ghost filter slots use buckets as fluid filters. Empty slots allow every fluid.

Accepts Overclock upgrades (maximum 40), and Fluid Capacity upgrades that add 10% of the base pull per upgrade (maximum 64). Redstone control is per head.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.transfer_node_e:
Attach to an energy buffer. Pulls energy through connected pipes into machines or cells the pipes touch.

By default it pulls 50 FE/t every 20 ticks. The GUI shows the last successful pull as FE/t. No item filter and no FE buffer.

Accepts Overclock upgrades (maximum 40), and Energy upgrades that add 25% of the base pull per upgrade (maximum 64). Redstone control is per head.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.filter.ghost: Click with an item to set a filter
jei.dopasrandomutilities.filter.info: A reusable item matcher. Right-click to set a 4x4 ghost list with Match/Ignore toggles for NBT, damage, and item tags. Nested Filters are allowed. Works in basically every machine that have filter slots.
Grows a powered machine's FE buffer and intake by 25% of the default per upgrade (not compounding).
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fluid_capacity_: Transfer-node (fluids) upgrade. Each upgrade adds 10% of the base pull amount (not compounding). Maximum 64.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.efficiency_upgr: Reduces the FE cost of each operation by 6% per upgrade (down to 10% remaining).
jei.dopasrandomutilities.range_upgrade.i: Adds %s to max working range per upgrade.
A crafting component used to make machine upgrades. Has no effect on its own.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.productivity_up:
Increase the output of compatible machines.

Each upgrade adds a percentage bonus to produced amount.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.overclock_upgra:
Increase the speed of compatible machines.

Each upgrade shortens process time by a percentage. Some machines can go pass 100% the initial speed.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.stack_upgrade.i: Transfer-node upgrade. While installed, each transfer moves up to 64 items, mixing types. Non-stackable items count as 1; a stack of 16 snowballs counts as 16. The node keeps pulling until it hits 64 items or nothing else can move.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fortune_mesh_up:
Fishnet-only upgrade that unlocks vanilla treasure fishing in open water and raises the chance to force a treasure catch.

Without this upgrade the fishnet only rolls fish and junk. Only works in vanilla open water (the same check as a fishing bobber), and only if rare loot is allowed in the fishnet config. Each Fortune Mesh adds a configurable treasure chance (default 10% per upgrade, up to 9). Maximum force chance is 90%, never guaranteed. 

Treasure Mesh overwrites this loot while installed. Does nothing in a small pond where treasure cannot drop.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.treasure_mesh_u: Fishnet-only upgrade. While installed, each catch rolls from a custom loot table that overwrites Fortune Mesh and vanilla fishing loot.
Weights are relative: higher weight is more likely, they do not add up to a 0–1 chance.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.stone:
A resource generator. Place matching blocks or fluids on its sides (and optionally below) to match a recipe, then insert results into an inventory above.

Some side resources are kept; others are consumed after a full cycle. Lock Output pins the last successful recipe. Accepts Productivity and Overclock upgrades (except Creative), plus redstone control.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.rando: A special resource generator that places ore blocks above itself when its recipe conditions are met.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.metal: A special resource generator that places metal blocks above itself when its recipe conditions are met.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.creat: Creative variant: upgrades cannot be installed.
